# La Victoria Berlin

Peruvian street food restaurant at Markthalle Pfefferberg in Prenzlauer Berg, Berlin. Anticuchos, ceviche, papa rellena, sanguches (pan con chicharrón, pollo a la brasa), salchipapa, and traditional Peruvian drinks. Open Tuesday to Sunday.
